reasoning: Independent NeuroPharm patients and controls re-test diagnostic vigilance findings and iSPOT-D treatment response. The framework review and the contrasting Schmidt et al. (2017) study are context rather than selected replication targets. Literal layout quotes retain interleaved columns.
